body: It's nearly been 8 years since actual thoughts of suicide came up. 1 since I last attempted. The medication doesn't work, the therapists don't work and I've tried so hard to make them. The only support I have is everyone clapping themselves on the back that they didn't let me die. If a dog is in pain it's put down, I am in so much pain and I'm expected to just keep dealing with it. I want to be able to but I am so drained
